title: Extract the learned head with trusted fitting and calibration guards
description:
## Scope

Port the minimal reusable learned-head/refit path from Jev-Flywheel. Fit only trusted labels with full feature coverage and explicit selection propensities; use propensity weighting and out-of-fold predictions for calibration. Context optimization and learned-head fitting are separate versioned interventions.

## Definition of done

Failure specs reject untrusted labels, missing propensities, missing features, and in-sample calibration; a fake-engine fixture produces reproducible numbers.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Extract the learned head with trusted fitting and calibration guards
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given feedback labels with incomplete feature coverage or missing propensity
    When a learned-head fit is requested
    Then the fit rejects or drops invalid rows according to an explicit policy rather than guessing values
```
